newsitem.title: LATVIA: BALTA INSURANCE SHARE ISSUE OVERSUBSCRIBED. [CORRECTED 13:17 GMT]
newsitem.headline: BALTA INSURANCE SHARE ISSUE OVERSUBSCRIBED. [CORRECTED 13:17 GMT]

text.p: Balta Insurance's issue of 200,000 shares priced at 1.75 lats each was oversubscribed by 70.3 times (corrects from seventy-eight times), Trasta Bank said on Wednesday.
"This means that investors have applied for 14.07 million shares and the total value of the bids reached 24.63 million lats," the Trasta Bank said in a statement.
Balta, the biggest insurance company in the Baltic states by way of paid capital, is expected to be quoted on the Riga stock exchange in the first week of September, the bank added in the statement.
Subscribers included 16 local legal entities, 300 individuals and seven foreign legal entities and seven individuals, the statement said. The final payment date for the issue is August 15.
"The results of the Balta subscription show its price could have been higher, a sign of the big potential of the Latvian stock market," the statement said.
"This also enables us to forecast increased activity on the market as more businesses go public," the statement added.
